problem: The project requires Original Baseline plus lesion/rescue/replay evidence before historical Frank organs/functions may be fused or dissolved, but lacks a machine-native reproducible mechanism that converts those causal traces into an evidence-scoped architecture quotient.
candidate: Compile reconstructed Frank behavior into protected-observable/intervention-labelled transition semantics; refine to the coarsest causal partition supported by the declared evidence; preserve historical lineage in every class; emit a quotient architecture plan and revocable QuotientCertificate bound to baseline refs, semantic epoch, protected observables, intervention alphabet and test corpus.
certificate_law: CQC never claims universal equivalence. New material observable, intervention, semantic epoch, baseline ancestry change or failed replay invalidates the certificate and forces refinement/revalidation.
synthetic_meaning: The discriminator shows that normal/output equivalence can be dangerously overaggressive and that intervention-scoped equivalence can remove exact duplicates without the modeled causal errors. It does not establish real Frank redundancy, target-VPS savings, or superiority over conventional testing/manual fusion.

strongest_counterhypothesis.statement: Purpose-built conventional protected regression + lesion/replay suite + ordinary compiler optimization + manual fusion matches CQC defect coverage and safety with less compiler/meta-architecture complexity.
strongest_counterhypothesis.kill_rule: Reject CQC if this baseline matches protected fault detection, replay/recovery parity and reproducibility on real Frank baselines with materially lower complexity/resources.

prior_art: Bisimulation minimization, state abstraction, causal abstraction under interventions, soft interventions, approximate abstraction and equality saturation are established; no world-first claim.

prior_atomic_relations.PSW: refuted distinct architecture; no duplicate representation claim
prior_atomic_relations.SPL: no unique benefit; no translator scope overlap
prior_atomic_relations.GAR: runtime superiority refuted; CQC does not mint authority
prior_atomic_relations.CARF: concurrent complementary causal-credit candidate; its receipts can become protected CQC observables

required_next_real_test: Wait for an executable bounded current Frank component and its applicable Original Baseline package; derive protected observable/intervention signatures; compare CQC against manual protected regression/compiler fusion on matched lesions, shuffled/provenance-broken/no-reentry, authority stale-generation, crash/restart/rollback and held-out/OOD workloads on the accepted target VPS.
